fieldValues.title: AI agent in Programme coordination
fieldValues.summary: An agent claiming, building, reviewing or reporting programme work within a group's mandate, starting each run from scratch.
goals: Take only work that is grounded and within its mandate
Leave work finished or cleanly handed over
Escalate what is outside its authority
jobs: Claim an issue and build it
Review another member's work and post a quorum
Find out what changed since it last looked
fieldValues.needs: A clear queue, the group's rules of engagement in the records, and tools that tell it which build and state it is acting on.
